empty.title: No team members yet
empty.description: Add the doctors and secretaries who work in your clinic. Each one receives an invitation by email.

noResults.title: No team members match
noResults.description: Try another search or clear the filters.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.consequence: {{name}} is signed out immediately and can no longer sign in. Their history in the clinic is kept.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
reactivate.consequence: {{name}} can sign in again with their existing password. If they never activated their account, it returns to “Invitation sent” and you can resend the invitation.

invitation.sent: A new invitation has been sent to {{email}}.

passwordReset.title: Reset password for {{name}}?
passwordReset.consequence: {{name}} receives an email at {{email}} with a link to choose a new password. The link works for one hour. When they use it, they are signed out everywhere.
passwordReset.done: A password reset link has been sent to {{email}}.

help.email: The invitation is sent here. It becomes their sign-in email.
help.emailLocked: The sign-in email cannot be changed once the account is activated.
help.additionalSpecialty: Sub-specialty or area of interest, in your own words.

roleOptions.DOCTOR: Sees patients, records consultations, and has their own schedule.
roleOptions.SECRETARY: Books appointments and manages the calendar. No access to medical records.

new.title: Add team member
new.created: {{name}} has been added and invited by email.
new.scheduleLater: Working hours are set up in Schedules once the member has been added.

member.invitedBanner: {{name}} has not activated their account yet. Invitation links are valid for 72 hours.
member.deactivatedBanner: This account is deactivated. {{name}} cannot sign in.
